mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stellar_spu ( name, sub_title, category_id, description, description_md, main_image, sub_images, slider_images, sale_count, comment_count, total_stock, sku_count, min_price, max_price, is_new, is_hot, sort, status, on_shelf_time, off_shelf_time, create_time, create_user, update_time, update_user ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{subTitle}, #{categoryId}, #{description}, #{descriptionMd}, #{mainImage}, #{subImages}, #{sliderImages}, #{saleCount}, #{commentCount}, #{totalStock}, #{skuCount}, #{minPrice}, #{maxPrice}, #{isNew}, #{isHot}, #{sort}, #{status}, #{onShelfTime}, #{offShelfTime}, #{createTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateTime}, #{updateUser} )
mapper.update: UPDATE stellar_spu SET min_price = #{minPrice}, max_price = #{maxPrice}, total_stock = #{totalStock}, sku_count = #{skuCount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
